sourceRefs.locator: Chapter One, “Heian Court Culture and the Transmission of the Tale”, pp. 88–89. Shōshi’s son, the diary, transcription, Michinaga’s supplies and the draft.
Kyoto Gyoen National Garden, interpretation of Michinaga’s residence, Shōshi and the births of the later emperors Go-Ichijō and Go-Suzaku.
Basic information, record 270000201500 (Tsuchimikado residence site), coordinates.

note.de: Als Shōshi im Haus ihres Vaters einen Sohn bekommt, arbeitet Murasaki an einer Abschrift ihrer Erzählung. Ihr Tagebuch berichtet, was mit einem Entwurf geschieht.
note.en: While Shōshi is at her father’s house for the birth of a son, Murasaki oversees a copy of her tale. Her diary records what becomes of one draft.
